from: Polymarket's docs, "Error Codes" (docs.polymarket.com/resources/error-codes), read 2026-11-12: status 503 under "POST order", which the page explains as "The exchange is in cancel-only mode. You can cancel existing orders but cannot place new orders." Its post-only twin reads "post-only mode: only post-only orders and cancels are allowed".

body.error: Trading is currently cancel-only. New orders are not accepted, but cancels are allowed.
